remarks: Springdale 2 Bed 1.5 Bath Triplex charming townhouse offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Nestled in a serene neighborhood, it boasts a modern design and an inviting atmosphere. Open-concept layout features a bright living room, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. The kitchen is equipped with newer appliances, ample wood cabinetry, and a breakfast bar, making it a entertaining a delight. Oversized 2 Bedrooms each offering generous closet space and natural light. Enjoy the private deck & yard area, ideal for outdoor dining or gardening. Situated close to local parks, shops, and public transportation, it offers easy access to all that Springdale has to offer. Includes a private carport along with a finished lower level with walk out sliders to a private deck allows a lot of flexibility. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer or looking to downsize, this townhouse is a must-see!
